Method of Attack: Distributes ransomware via a fake Adobe Flash Player update executable (flashplayer_install.exe) that installs ransomware components (dec.exe and enc.exe) to encrypt victim files and demand ransom.
Checks browser USER-AGENT for Windows OS to trigger ransomware download; otherwise shows defacement page.
Discoverer: Ido Naor, Principal Security Researcher at Kaspersky Lab
Attack Vector: DNS hijacking of nagich.com plugin to load malicious script on websites using the plugin
Malicious script served via update.html page redirect
Fake Adobe Flash Player update prompt to trick users into downloading ransomware executable
Indicators of Compromise: Extracted files: enc.exe, dec.exe, PersonalKey.txt in Startup folder
